en.name: Standard Bearer
en.ability: When you are nominated, you may make a unique public statement about the nominator (not yourself). Tonight, you learn if the statement was true.

revisions.v1: When you are nominated, you may make a unique public statement about the nominator (not yourself). Tonight, you learn if the statement was true.

en.flavor: "Say not always what you know. But always know what you say." - Tiberius Claudius Caesar Augustus Germanicus 10 B.C - 54 A.D.
en.otherNightReminder: If the Standard Bearer's public statement was true: show the head signal (nod 'true'). Otherwise: show the head signal (shake 'false').

zh.name: 掌旗官
zh.ability: 当你被提名时，你可以公开发表一个关于提名者（不能是你自己）的独特声明。当晚你会得知该声明是否正确。

revisions.v1: 当你被提名时，你可以公开发表一个关于提名者（不能是你自己）的独特声明。当晚你会得知该声明是否正确。

zh.flavor: ‘不要总是说你知道的事，但总是要知道你在说什么。’-提比略·克劳狄乌斯·凯撒·奥古斯都·日耳曼尼库斯 前10-54
zh.otherNightReminder: 如果掌旗官在今天白天被提名并发表了一个关于提名者的独特声明，唤醒掌旗官，通过点头或摇头来告知他这个声明是否正确。
